title: Meta-analysis of Asymptomatic Monkeypox Virus Prevalence in Nonendemic Regions, 2022-2024.
abstract: In this meta-analysis, we performed a literature search for articles relating to asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detections published worldwide during May 12, 2022-September 13, 2024. The primary outcome was to determine the pooled prevalence of asymptomatic MPXV detections. We conducted a random-effects analysis that yielded a final pooled prevalence of 1.0% (95% prediction interval 0.1%-11.2%). Results did not substantially differ by geographic region or study design. Although those findings are reassuring, we did not evaluate infectivity or transmission potential among asymptomatic persons. MPXV continues to circulate globally; the viral dynamics that enable its persistence remain poorly understood and merit further study.

analysis.summary_en: This meta-analysis examined articles on asymptomatic monkeypox virus (MPXV) detections published worldwide from May 12, 2022 through September 13, 2024. Its primary objective was to estimate the pooled prevalence of asymptomatic MPXV detections. Using a random-effects analysis, the review reported a final pooled prevalence of 1.0%, with a 95% prediction interval of 0.1% to 11.2%. The authors noted that results did not substantially differ by geographic region or study design. However, the supplied evidence does not report study counts, eligibility criteria, heterogeneity measures, or specific conflicting findings. A major limitation is that the review did not evaluate infectivity or transmission potential among asymptomatic persons, leaving that public health question unresolved. The authors also state that MPXV continues to circulate globally and that the viral dynamics enabling its persistence remain poorly understood. These findings support further research into MPXV persistence and transmission, but they do not provide sufficient evidence to establish specific surveillance, diagnostic, treatment, vaccination, or policy recommendations.

title: Timely evidence generation in epidemic response: lessons from an attempted analytical epidemiological investigation during an mpox outbreak, Ireland, 2022.
abstract: The emergence of mpox cases in Ireland in May 2022 triggered an urgent public health response, including an attempted analytical epidemiological investigation aimed at informing vaccination strategies and risk communication, particularly among gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men. At the time of implementation, case numbers had declined to an extent that limited recruitment, resulting in early suspension of data collection. We present a structured reflection of the investigation, drawing on a lessons learnt review and the experiences of those involved, to offer actionable recommendations to strengthen evidence generation in future outbreak preparedness and response efforts. Key lessons include the critical importance of stakeholder engagement, clear governance and legal frameworks, and the need for enhanced procedural preparedness and pre-established surge capacity arrangements to enable rapid analytical investigations during health emergencies. These insights align closely with Ireland's National Health Protection Strategy and the extended mandate of the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control. Beyond existing international frameworks for outbreak preparedness, this reflection highlights the practical implementation barriers that must be addressed to enable timely and coordinated epidemiological investigations across Europe.

title: Mpox Vaccine Acceptance Among Health Care Workers in Central Asia: The Role of COVID-19 Experience.
abstract: Abstract Background The COVID-19 pandemic may have shaped health care workers’ (HCWs’) perceptions of emerging infectious threats and willingness to adopt new vaccines. This study examined whether COVID-19-related experiences and psychological factors were associated with Mpox vaccine acceptance among HCWs in Central Asia. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 3,054 HCWs from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan completed an online survey between July and November 2022. Mpox vaccine acceptance was assessed using a single 5-point Likert-scale item and analyzed as a continuous outcome. Measures included COVID-19-related experiences, fear of COVID-19 and Mpox, DASS-21, and occupational burnout. Analyses included comparative tests, multivariable linear regression, and exploratory mediation models. Results Overall, 1,868 HCWs (61.2%) reported some willingness to receive Mpox vaccination, whereas 1,186 (38.8%) reported none. In bivariate analyses, acceptance varied by country and was higher among HCWs with COVID-19 frontline experience or living with high-risk individuals. In multivariable regression, fear of Mpox was the strongest correlate of acceptance, while burnout was inversely associated. Mediation analyses indicated indirect associations through fear- and distress-related pathways. Conclusions Mpox vaccine acceptance among Central Asian HCWs was associated with pandemic experience and psychological responses to infectious disease risk. Strategies should combine risk communication with burnout reduction and HCW well-being support.

title_zh: 猴痘 疫苗 中亚卫生保健工作者的接受度:COVID-19 经验的作用。
source_body_en: Abstract Background The COVID-19 pandemic may have shaped health care workers’ (HCWs’) perceptions of emerging infectious threats and willingness to adopt new vaccines. This study examined whether COVID-19-related experiences and psychological factors were associated with Mpox vaccine acceptance among HCWs in Central Asia. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 3,054 HCWs from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan completed an online survey between July and November 2022. Mpox vaccine acceptance was assessed using a single 5-point Likert-scale item and analyzed as a continuous outcome. Measures included COVID-19-related experiences, fear of COVID-19 and Mpox, DASS-21, and occupational burnout. Analyses included comparative tests, multivariable linear regression, and exploratory mediation models. Results Overall, 1,868 HCWs (61.2%) reported some willingness to receive Mpox vaccination, whereas 1,186 (38.8%) reported none. In bivariate analyses, acceptance varied by country and was higher among HCWs with COVID-19 frontline experience or living with high-risk individuals. In multivariable regression, fear of Mpox was the strongest correlate of acceptance, while burnout was inversely associated. Mediation analyses indicated indirect associations through fear- and distress-related pathways. Conclusions Mpox vaccine acceptance among Central Asian HCWs was associated with pandemic experience and psychological responses to infectious disease risk. Strategies should combine risk communication with burnout reduction and HCW well-being support.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 COVID-19 大流行可能影响了医护人员 (HCW) 对新出现的传染病威胁的看法以及采用新 疫苗 的意愿。本研究调查了中亚医护人员中与 COVID-19 相关的经历和心理因素是否与 猴痘 疫苗 接受程度相关。方法 在这项横断面研究中,来自哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦的 3,054 名医护人员在 2022 年 7 月至 11 月期间完成了一项在线调查。使用单个 5 点李克特量表项目评估 猴痘 疫苗 接受度,并作为连续结果进行分析。衡量标准包括与 COVID-19 相关的经历、对 COVID-19 和 猴痘、DASS-21 的恐惧以及职业倦怠。分析包括比较测试、多变量线性回归和探索性中介模型。结果 总体而言,1,868 名医护人员 (61.2%) 表示愿意接受 猴痘 疫苗接种,而 1,186 名 (38.8%) 则表示没有意愿。在双变量分析中,不同国家/地区的接受程度有所不同,具有 COVID-19 前线经验或与高危人群生活在一起的医护人员的接受程度较高。在多变量回归中,对 猴痘 的恐惧是与接受程度最强的相关性,而倦怠则呈负相关。中介分析表明通过恐惧和痛苦相关途径存在间接关联。结论 中亚医护人员对 猴痘 疫苗 的接受度与大流行经历和对传染病风险的心理反应相关。策略应将风险沟通与减少倦怠和医护人员福祉支持结合起来。

title: Validation of self-reported mpox vaccination in men who have sex with men.
abstract: The Australian Government introduced a nationwide mpox MVA-BN vaccine to all eligible individuals at higher risk of mpox exposure, specifically gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM). Self-reported vaccination status is commonly used in surveillance and behavioural research, but its accuracy for mpox vaccination is unknown. We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional study of GBMSM aged ≥16 years who attended the Melbourne Sexual Health Centre (MSHC) between 7 December 2023 and 31 December 2024. Self-reported mpox vaccination status using computer-assisted self-interviewing (CASI) was compared to verified electronic health records. Sensitivity, specificity, and agreement (κ) were calculated alongside other measures of performance. Of 6050 eligible men, 5885 men self-reported their mpox vaccination status: 48.6% (n = 2859) vaccinated, 44.6% (n = 2623) unvaccinated, and 6.8% (n = 403) unsure. Self-reported mpox vaccination had a sensitivity of 96.9% (95% CI: 95.9% to 97.7%), a specificity of 65.4% (95% CI: 63.9% to 66.9%), a positive predictive value of 52.4% (95% CI: 50.6% to 54.3%), a negative predictive value of 98.2% (95% CI: 97.6% to 98.6%), and an accuracy of 74.3% (95% CI: 73.1% to 75.5%). Our results demonstrated that the majority of GBMSM correctly reported their vaccination status. While self-reported mpox vaccination demonstrates high sensitivity, moderate agreement indicates residual misclassification and incomplete capture of vaccinations in the electronic health record used for validation. This suggests that while self-report is reliable for confirming non-vaccination, it is less reliable for identifying vaccinated individuals, underscoring the importance of electronic health record verification for accurate vaccine surveillance.

abstract_zh: 澳大利亚政府向所有符合 猴痘 暴露风险较高的符合条件的个人推出了全国性的 猴痘 MVA-BN 疫苗,特别是同性恋、双性恋和其他男男性行为者 (GBMSM)。自我报告的 疫苗接种 状态常用于 监测 和行为研究,但其对于 猴痘 疫苗接种 的准确性未知。我们对2023年12月7日至2024年12月31日期间到墨尔本性健康中心(MSHC)就诊的年龄≥16岁的GBMSM进行了一项回顾性横断面研究。将使用计算机辅助自我访谈(CASI)自我报告的猴痘 疫苗接种状态与经过验证的电子健康记录进行比较。灵敏度、特异性和一致性 (κ) 与其他性能指标一起计算。在 6050 名符合资格的男性中,有 5885 名男性自我报告了他们的 猴痘 疫苗接种 状态:48.6% (n = 2859) 接种了疫苗,44.6% (n = 2623) 未接种疫苗,6.8% (n = 403) 不确定。自我报告的 猴痘 疫苗接种 的敏感性为 96.9%(95% CI:95.9% 至 97.7%),特异性为 65.4%(95% CI:63.9% 至 66.9%),阳性预测值为 52.4%(95% CI:50.6% 至 54.3%),阴性预测值为 98.2%(95% CI:97.6% 至 98.6%),准确率为 74.3%(95% CI:73.1% 至 75.5%)。我们的结果表明,大多数 GBMSM 正确报告了其 疫苗接种 状态。虽然自我报告的 猴痘 疫苗接种 表现出高敏感性,但中等一致性表明用于验证的电子健康记录中存在残留错误分类和 疫苗接种 的不完整捕获。这表明,虽然自我报告对于确认非 疫苗接种 是可靠的,但对于识别接种疫苗的个体来说不太可靠,这强调了电子健康记录验证对于准确的 疫苗 监测 的重要性。

title: Cocirculation of Human Monkeypox Virus Clade 1b with Varicella Zoster Virus, Uganda.
abstract: In July 2024, we reported information on the initial human mpox cases in Uganda. Genomic characterization of clinically suspected cases (July-December 2024) revealed cocirculation of several monkeypox virus clade 1b clusters and varicella zoster virus. Our findings highlight the need to refine differential diagnoses by molecular techniques and strengthen surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the cocirculation of human monkeypox virus clade 1b with varicella zoster virus in Uganda during July-December 2024. The research aimed to understand the coexistence of these viruses, addressing the need for improved differential diagnoses and surveillance. Genomic characterization was used to identify viral clusters, revealing the presence of both viruses in the same population. The findings highlight the complexity of viral interactions in the region and emphasize the importance of molecular techniques in accurate diagnosis. The study's limitations include reliance on clinically suspected cases, which may introduce bias, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the observational approach. These results have implications for refining diagnostic methods and strengthening surveillance systems to better monitor viral cocirculation and potential public health risks.

title: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023-May 2025.
abstract: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023-May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023-May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%-16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%-96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%-46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%-85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

title: Monkeypox Virus in Healthcare Settings, Sierra Leone, June 2025.
abstract: During the 2025 mpox outbreak in Sierra Leone, we assessed environmental contamination in 2 hospitals. Of 89 surfaces sampled, 6 (6.7%) surface samples, primarily from doors, were PCR-positive for monkeypox virus. Our findings highlight monkeypox virus surface contamination in healthcare settings and help prioritize infection prevention and control targets in resource-limited settings.

title: Emergence and co-circulation of Clade Ib and Clade IIb Mpox viruses in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Pakistan, 2024–2026: clinical, genomic, and public health insights from a non-endemic region
abstract: Mpox remains a global public health concern, with increasing reports of travel-associated and locally acquired infections outside historically endemic regions. Pakistan is particularly vulnerable to repeated introductions because of extensive labor migration to Gulf countries and limited decentralized diagnostics. We aimed to characterize the clinical, epidemiological, and genomic features of Mpox cases detected in Pakistan during 2024-26 and assess evidence of local transmission. We conducted a descriptive cross-sectional study of all patients meeting WHO Mpox suspected-case criteria and reported through the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa-Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response System between August 1, 2024 and April 16, 2026. Clinical and epidemiological data were retrieved via standardized surveillance forms. Diagnostic confirmation used real-time PCR, and whole-genome sequencing (WGS; Illumina iSeq) was performed on samples with Ct ≤ 23. Among 137 suspected cases, 29 were laboratory-confirmed. Median age was 31 years (range 0.6–80 years); 20 (68.9%) were male, eight (27.6%) female, and one (3.4%) transgender. Thirteen (44.8%) infections were imported, five (17.2%) were secondary transmission cases, six (20.7%) were locally acquired, and five (17.2%) were classified as probable local infections. Vesiculopustular rash was present in all cases (100%), followed by fever (82.8%), musculoskeletal pain (37.9%), genital or perianal lesions (34.5%) and sore throat (24.1%). Clinical illness was generally mild, and with most patients recovered completely; however, two patients died during the course of illness. Whole-genome sequencing of four representative cases identified both Clade IIb (lineage A.2.1) and Clade Ib viruses. Phylogenetic analysis showed close genetic relationships of the Pakistani genomes with sequences reported from Pakistan, the United States, Nepal, and Thailand. A locally acquired case was assigned to Clade Ib, providing the first genomic detection of Clade Ib in Pakistan. The first genomic detection of Clade Ib, alongside detection of Clade IIb, highlights the genetic diversity of MPXV detected in Pakistan. Epidemiological investigation identified both imported and locally acquired infections, underscoring the need for strengthened genomic surveillance, decentralized diagnostics, and improved access to vaccines and therapeutics.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 仍然是一个全球公共卫生问题,越来越多关于历史流行地区以外的旅行相关感染和本地感染的报告。该研究旨在描述 2024-26 年间在巴基斯坦发现的 猴痘 病例的临床、流行病学和基因组特征,并评估当地 猴痘 的证据。

title_zh: 2024-2026 年巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省 Ib 分支和 IIb 分支 猴痘病毒 的出现和共同循环:来自非流行地区的临床、基因组和公共卫生见解
source_body_en: Mpox remains a global public health concern, with increasing reports of travel-associated and locally acquired infections outside historically endemic regions. Pakistan is particularly vulnerable to repeated introductions because of extensive labor migration to Gulf countries and limited decentralized diagnostics. We aimed to characterize the clinical, epidemiological, and genomic features of Mpox cases detected in Pakistan during 2024-26 and assess evidence of local transmission. We conducted a descriptive cross-sectional study of all patients meeting WHO Mpox suspected-case criteria and reported through the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa-Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response System between August 1, 2024 and April 16, 2026. Clinical and epidemiological data were retrieved via standardized surveillance forms. Diagnostic confirmation used real-time PCR, and whole-genome sequencing (WGS; Illumina iSeq) was performed on samples with Ct ≤ 23. Among 137 suspected cases, 29 were laboratory-confirmed. Median age was 31 years (range 0.6–80 years); 20 (68.9%) were male, eight (27.6%) female, and one (3.4%) transgender. Thirteen (44.8%) infections were imported, five (17.2%) were secondary transmission cases, six (20.7%) were locally acquired, and five (17.2%) were classified as probable local infections. Vesiculopustular rash was present in all cases (100%), followed by fever (82.8%), musculoskeletal pain (37.9%), genital or perianal lesions (34.5%) and sore throat (24.1%). Clinical illness was generally mild, and with most patients recovered completely; however, two patients died during the course of illness. Whole-genome sequencing of four representative cases identified both Clade IIb (lineage A.2.1) and Clade Ib viruses. Phylogenetic analysis showed close genetic relationships of the Pakistani genomes with sequences reported from Pakistan, the United States, Nepal, and Thailand. A locally acquired case was assigned to Clade Ib, providing the first genomic detection of Clade Ib in Pakistan. The first genomic detection of Clade Ib, alongside detection of Clade IIb, highlights the genetic diversity of MPXV detected in Pakistan. Epidemiological investigation identified both imported and locally acquired infections, underscoring the need for strengthened genomic surveillance, decentralized diagnostics, and improved access to vaccines and therapeutics.

title: A qualitative study of the 2025 mpox epidemic in Sierra Leone as a multidimensional social phenomenon
abstract: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) caused 5442 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in Sierra Leone in 2025. Epidemiological and genomic studies describe its scale and lineage, but not how people governed, interpreted, lived, and survived it. We conducted an interpretive qualitative study in Western Area Urban and Port Loko District. Purposive maximum-variation sampling included survivors, caregivers, clinicians, surveillance and contact-tracing staff, community health workers, community leaders, and policy actors. Fifty-two people completed in-depth interviews. Thirty-eight different people joined six focus group discussions, yielding 90 unique participants. Data collection occurred in Krio, Temne, Mende, and English. We combined the Framework Method with reflexive thematic analysis across six interacting dimensions: structural, institutional, cultural, relational, subjective, and systemic. Material conditions constrained isolation and shifted control costs toward households. Emergency institutions made cases visible, but bed scarcity and frontline discretion shaped facility care. Visible lesions acquired moral meanings linked to sex, dirt, punishment, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and Ebola memory. Relationships carried infection, care, disclosure, stigma, and trusted information. Survivors described pain, shame, income loss, altered intimacy, and difficult reintegration. Ebola supplied the dominant bodily analogy, while COVID-19 shaped accounts of restrictions, vaccination, and response fatigue. System limits included workforce pressure, vaccine scarcity, and prolonged needs after clinical recovery. Mpox control required diagnosis, isolation, and vaccination, but technical measures worked through social conditions. Effective response therefore needs livelihood support, safe household care, trusted communication, stigma reduction, survivor follow-up, and transparent resource allocation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) caused 5442 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in Sierra Leone in 2025. The study aimed to understand the epidemic as a multidimensional social phenomenon.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Western Area Urban and Port Loko District. Purposive maximum-variation sampling included survivors, caregivers, clinicians, surveillance and contact-tracing staff, community health workers, community leaders, and policy actors.
analysis.methods: An interpretive qualitative study was conducted using the Framework Method combined with reflexive thematic analysis across six interacting dimensions: structural, institutional, cultural, relational, subjective, and systemic.
analysis.main_results: Epidemiological and genomic studies describe the scale and lineage of the mpox epidemic, but they do not explain how people governed, interpreted, lived, and survived it.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that mpox control required diagnosis, isolation, and vaccination, but these technical measures worked through social conditions rather than in isolation.

title_zh: 对2025年塞拉利昂猴痘流行病作为多维社会现象的定性研究
source_body_en: Mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) caused 5442 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in Sierra Leone in 2025. Epidemiological and genomic studies describe its scale and lineage, but not how people governed, interpreted, lived, and survived it. We conducted an interpretive qualitative study in Western Area Urban and Port Loko District. Purposive maximum-variation sampling included survivors, caregivers, clinicians, surveillance and contact-tracing staff, community health workers, community leaders, and policy actors. Fifty-two people completed in-depth interviews. Thirty-eight different people joined six focus group discussions, yielding 90 unique participants. Data collection occurred in Krio, Temne, Mende, and English. We combined the Framework Method with reflexive thematic analysis across six interacting dimensions: structural, institutional, cultural, relational, subjective, and systemic. Material conditions constrained isolation and shifted control costs toward households. Emergency institutions made cases visible, but bed scarcity and frontline discretion shaped facility care. Visible lesions acquired moral meanings linked to sex, dirt, punishment, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), and Ebola memory. Relationships carried infection, care, disclosure, stigma, and trusted information. Survivors described pain, shame, income loss, altered intimacy, and difficult reintegration. Ebola supplied the dominant bodily analogy, while COVID-19 shaped accounts of restrictions, vaccination, and response fatigue. System limits included workforce pressure, vaccine scarcity, and prolonged needs after clinical recovery. Mpox control required diagnosis, isolation, and vaccination, but technical measures worked through social conditions. Effective response therefore needs livelihood support, safe household care, trusted communication, stigma reduction, survivor follow-up, and transparent resource allocation.
abstract_zh: 2025 年,猴痘(以前称为猴痘)在塞拉利昂造成 5442 例确诊病例和 60 人死亡。流行病学和基因组研究描述了其规模和谱系,但没有描述人们如何管理、解释、生活和生存。我们在西部地区城市和洛科港区进行了一项解释性定性研究。有目的的最大变异抽样包括幸存者、护理人员、临床医生、监测 和接触追踪人员、社区卫生工作者、社区领导和政策参与者。五十二人完成了深度访谈。38 名不同的人参加了 6 个焦点小组讨论,产生了 90 名独特的参与者。数据收集以 Krio、Temne、Mende 和英语进行。我们将框架方法与跨六个相互作用维度的反思性主题分析相结合:结构、制度、文化、关系、主观和系统。物质条件限制了隔离,并将控制成本转移给了家庭。应急机构使病例可见,但床位稀缺和一线自由裁量权影响了设施护理。可见的损伤获得了与性、污垢、惩罚、人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)和埃博拉记忆相关的道德意义。关系承载着感染、关怀、披露、耻辱和可信信息。幸存者描述了痛苦、羞耻、收入损失、亲密关系改变以及重新融入社会的困难。埃博拉提供了主要的身体类比,而 COVID-19 则塑造了对限制、疫苗接种 和反应疲劳的描述。系统限制包括劳动力压力、疫苗 稀缺以及临床康复后的长期需求。猴痘 控制需要 诊断、隔离和 疫苗接种,但技术措施通过社会条件发挥作用。因此,有效的应对措施需要生计支持、安全的家庭护理、可信的沟通、减少耻辱、幸存者跟踪和透明的资源分配。

title: The Pathogenesis of Atypical Clinical Presentations of Monkeypox Virus Infections
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an ongoing global public health concern. Historically associated with zoonotic infection, in 2022, a major epidemiological shift occurred when sustained transmission was identified across multiple countries that previously had not had endemic circulation of the virus. While mpox typically presents with characteristic clinical features, infection can also lead to a spectrum of less common manifestations involving multiple organ systems. The extent of viral dissemination and disease severity appear to be modulated by host factors such as immune status, vaccination history, co-infections, and potentially the viral clade. Although complications associated with mpox are infrequent, they can lead to significant morbidity and mortality. Moreover, the underlying pathogenesis and to what extent the viral clade may be playing a role remain incompletely understood. This review summarizes the less common clinical complications of mpox, explores the underlying mechanisms of viral pathogenesis, and discusses what insights can be gained from cell culture and animal models. Additionally, we highlight knowledge gaps that can guide future research priorities.

source_body_en: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an ongoing global public health concern. Historically associated with zoonotic infection, in 2022, a major epidemiological shift occurred when sustained transmission was identified across multiple countries that previously had not had endemic circulation of the virus. While mpox typically presents with characteristic clinical features, infection can also lead to a spectrum of less common manifestations involving multiple organ systems. The extent of viral dissemination and disease severity appear to be modulated by host factors such as immune status, vaccination history, co-infections, and potentially the viral clade. Although complications associated with mpox are infrequent, they can lead to significant morbidity and mortality. Moreover, the underlying pathogenesis and to what extent the viral clade may be playing a role remain incompletely understood. This review summarizes the less common clinical complications of mpox, explores the underlying mechanisms of viral pathogenesis, and discusses what insights can be gained from cell culture and animal models. Additionally, we highlight knowledge gaps that can guide future research priorities.

title: Computational insights into monkeypox clade II protein interactions with human proteins HACE1 TTBK2 and KLHL3 in reproductive tissues
abstract: Because of its increased tissue tropism and potential sexual transmission, the Clade II Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has caused serious concerns globally. Although MPXV’s host entry and immune evasion mechanisms have been studied, little is known about how it can exploit host reproductive tissues, proteins, and associated pathways. We investigated whether MPXV Clade II proteins exhibit putative structural resemblance to host reproductive proteins with the potential to dysregulate tissue-specific signalling pathways. Differentially expressed genes (DEG) identified in infected host datasets were intersected with reproductive tissue-enriched proteins derived from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA). Comparative analysis revealed potential targets that could be altered in reproductive tissues during MPXV infection, especially via sexual transmission. To evaluate host–pathogen interactions based on structural resemblance, the host and viral protein sequences of identified DEGs were aligned, followed by structural modelling with AlphaFold2, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation. Key viral proteins- OPG037 and OPG187- showed high structural similarity to host HACE1 and TTBK2, respectively, generating the hypothesis that OPG037 may bind RAC1, a crucial GTPase controlling cellular migration. Similarly, the Kelch and BTB-BACK domains of KLHL3 showed putative structural similarity to the Kelch and BTB-BACK domains of MPXV Kelch-like protein. It raises the hypothesis that it may compete with the host Kelch domain of KLHL3 to bind WNK3 and the BTB-BACK domain of KLHL3 to bind CUL3. These findings suggest MPXV Clade II proteins exhibit putative structural resemblance with potential functional implications requiring validation. This study elucidates docking-based host–pathogen interactions to generate hypotheses on molecular mechanisms behind viral pathogenesis in sexual organs. This provides insights essential for mitigating the spread of emerging MPXV variants with enhanced potential for human-to-human sexual transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 Clade II 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 的组织向性增加和潜在的性 传播 引起了全球关注,因此需要进行这项研究。该研究旨在调查 MPXV Clade II 蛋白是否与 宿主 生殖蛋白表现出假定的结构相似性,并有可能失调组织特异性信号通路。

title_zh: 生殖组织中猴痘进化枝 II 蛋白与人类蛋白 HACE1 TTBK2 和 KLHL3 相互作用的计算见解
source_body_en: Because of its increased tissue tropism and potential sexual transmission, the Clade II Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has caused serious concerns globally. Although MPXV’s host entry and immune evasion mechanisms have been studied, little is known about how it can exploit host reproductive tissues, proteins, and associated pathways. We investigated whether MPXV Clade II proteins exhibit putative structural resemblance to host reproductive proteins with the potential to dysregulate tissue-specific signalling pathways. Differentially expressed genes (DEG) identified in infected host datasets were intersected with reproductive tissue-enriched proteins derived from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA). Comparative analysis revealed potential targets that could be altered in reproductive tissues during MPXV infection, especially via sexual transmission. To evaluate host–pathogen interactions based on structural resemblance, the host and viral protein sequences of identified DEGs were aligned, followed by structural modelling with AlphaFold2, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation. Key viral proteins- OPG037 and OPG187- showed high structural similarity to host HACE1 and TTBK2, respectively, generating the hypothesis that OPG037 may bind RAC1, a crucial GTPase controlling cellular migration. Similarly, the Kelch and BTB-BACK domains of KLHL3 showed putative structural similarity to the Kelch and BTB-BACK domains of MPXV Kelch-like protein. It raises the hypothesis that it may compete with the host Kelch domain of KLHL3 to bind WNK3 and the BTB-BACK domain of KLHL3 to bind CUL3. These findings suggest MPXV Clade II proteins exhibit putative structural resemblance with potential functional implications requiring validation. This study elucidates docking-based host–pathogen interactions to generate hypotheses on molecular mechanisms behind viral pathogenesis in sexual organs. This provides insights essential for mitigating the spread of emerging MPXV variants with enhanced potential for human-to-human sexual transmission.

title: Summarizing the characteristics of mpox among people with and without HIV in Hubei Province, China
abstract: Currently, few studies have compared the difference of monkeypox (mpox) virus (MPXV) DNA detection in different specimens between people living with HIV (PLWH) and HIV-uninfected patients with mpox, and research on the comparison of clinical characteristics between them remains limited in China. A retrospective observational study was conducted between July 2023 and September 2024 in Hubei Province, China. All patients with mpox were recruited from Wuhan Jinyintan Hospital and Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University. Comparisons of the MPXV DNA detection in different clinical specimens and clinical characteristics were performed between PLWH and HIV-uninfected patients. Totally, 33 patients with mpox were enrolled; 32 (97.0%) were male, and 14 (42.4%) were PLWH. Two PLWH died, both of whom had CD4 + T-lymphocyte counts below 50 cells/μL, whereas no deaths occurred among HIV-uninfected patients. PLWH had higher positive rates of MPXV DNA detection in pox fluid, pox scab, anal swab, throat swab and blood plasma than HIV-uninfected patients, though no significant differences were observed between the two groups. Compared with HIV-uninfected patients, PLWH had significantly longer disease duration (27 vs. 16 days, p = 0.041), significantly lower CD4 counts ( p = 0.027) and lower proportion of lymphadenopathy ( p = 0.029). Among PLWH, a significantly negative correlation was observed between the disease duration and CD4 counts ( r =-0.784, p < 0.001). This small cohort has preliminarily found PLWH with mpox exhibited worse clinical outcomes due to immune deficiency. In PLWH, whether the higher positive detection rates of MPXV DNA in multiple specimens were related to transmissibility needs further verification with quantitative viral load detection and epidemiological investigation.

title_zh: 中国湖北省HIV感染者和未感染者猴痘的特征总结
source_body_en: Currently, few studies have compared the difference of monkeypox (mpox) virus (MPXV) DNA detection in different specimens between people living with HIV (PLWH) and HIV-uninfected patients with mpox, and research on the comparison of clinical characteristics between them remains limited in China. A retrospective observational study was conducted between July 2023 and September 2024 in Hubei Province, China. All patients with mpox were recruited from Wuhan Jinyintan Hospital and Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University. Comparisons of the MPXV DNA detection in different clinical specimens and clinical characteristics were performed between PLWH and HIV-uninfected patients. Totally, 33 patients with mpox were enrolled; 32 (97.0%) were male, and 14 (42.4%) were PLWH. Two PLWH died, both of whom had CD4 + T-lymphocyte counts below 50 cells/μL, whereas no deaths occurred among HIV-uninfected patients. PLWH had higher positive rates of MPXV DNA detection in pox fluid, pox scab, anal swab, throat swab and blood plasma than HIV-uninfected patients, though no significant differences were observed between the two groups. Compared with HIV-uninfected patients, PLWH had significantly longer disease duration (27 vs. 16 days, p = 0.041), significantly lower CD4 counts ( p = 0.027) and lower proportion of lymphadenopathy ( p = 0.029). Among PLWH, a significantly negative correlation was observed between the disease duration and CD4 counts ( r =-0.784, p < 0.001). This small cohort has preliminarily found PLWH with mpox exhibited worse clinical outcomes due to immune deficiency. In PLWH, whether the higher positive detection rates of MPXV DNA in multiple specimens were related to transmissibility needs further verification with quantitative viral load detection and epidemiological investigation.

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

title_zh: HECA-YOLOv11:一种高精度混合注意力网络,用于实时猴痘皮肤病变检测并具有可解释性
source_body_en: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区医护人员应对猴痘大流行的准备情况:快速回顾调查知识差距
source_body_en: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

title: Application and prospects of veterinary diagnostic techniques in laboratory monkeys
abstract: As the non-human primate models with the closest genetic relationship to humans, laboratory monkeys are indispensable in life sciences research, drug development, and biological product evaluation. However, infectious diseases either endemic in laboratory monkey colonies or acquired during breeding and husbandry—for example, B virus and Mycobacterium tuberculosis -threaten animal welfare and colony security, while also elevating zoonotic transmission risks and compromising the reliability of research data. The diversity, complexity, and clinically insidious nature of diseases in laboratory monkeys impose stringent demands on veterinary diagnostic capabilities. This review summarizes the current status and recent advances in mainstream veterinary diagnostic techniques applied to laboratory monkey disease surveillance. We analyze the specific applications, strengths, and limitations of molecular, immunological, imaging, and conventional microbiological methods for detecting major viral, bacterial, and parasitic pathogens of laboratory monkeys, covering quantitative PCR (qPCR), CRISPR-based assays, ELISA, IFA/IHC, and other established platforms. By comparing these techniques across sensitivity, specificity, cost-effectiveness, and operational feasibility, we delineate their suitability for distinct use cases: high-precision laboratory testing, large-scale colony screening, and point-of-care clinical diagnosis. Current veterinary diagnostic assays for laboratory monkeys achieve robust analytical performance. In several studies, qPCR delivers 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity for B virus detection, digital PCR (dPCR) attains a limit of detection as low as 45 copies/ml for monkeypox virus; and CRISPR/Cas-based assays have demonstrated 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity in clinical validation cohorts. Building on these advances, we further identify practical bottlenecks in diagnostic deployment and propose targeted countermeasures. Finally, we explore emerging trends and application prospects for point-of-care testing, multiplex pathogen detection, and artificial intelligence-assisted diagnosis, which collectively support the development of accurate, efficient, and intelligent disease diagnostics for laboratory monkeys. This work aims to provide a theoretical and practical reference for clinical practice and scientific research focused on laboratory monkey disease prevention and control.

title_zh: 兽医诊断技术在实验猴中的应用与展望
source_body_en: As the non-human primate models with the closest genetic relationship to humans, laboratory monkeys are indispensable in life sciences research, drug development, and biological product evaluation. However, infectious diseases either endemic in laboratory monkey colonies or acquired during breeding and husbandry—for example, B virus and Mycobacterium tuberculosis -threaten animal welfare and colony security, while also elevating zoonotic transmission risks and compromising the reliability of research data. The diversity, complexity, and clinically insidious nature of diseases in laboratory monkeys impose stringent demands on veterinary diagnostic capabilities. This review summarizes the current status and recent advances in mainstream veterinary diagnostic techniques applied to laboratory monkey disease surveillance. We analyze the specific applications, strengths, and limitations of molecular, immunological, imaging, and conventional microbiological methods for detecting major viral, bacterial, and parasitic pathogens of laboratory monkeys, covering quantitative PCR (qPCR), CRISPR-based assays, ELISA, IFA/IHC, and other established platforms. By comparing these techniques across sensitivity, specificity, cost-effectiveness, and operational feasibility, we delineate their suitability for distinct use cases: high-precision laboratory testing, large-scale colony screening, and point-of-care clinical diagnosis. Current veterinary diagnostic assays for laboratory monkeys achieve robust analytical performance. In several studies, qPCR delivers 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity for B virus detection, digital PCR (dPCR) attains a limit of detection as low as 45 copies/ml for monkeypox virus; and CRISPR/Cas-based assays have demonstrated 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity in clinical validation cohorts. Building on these advances, we further identify practical bottlenecks in diagnostic deployment and propose targeted countermeasures. Finally, we explore emerging trends and application prospects for point-of-care testing, multiplex pathogen detection, and artificial intelligence-assisted diagnosis, which collectively support the development of accurate, efficient, and intelligent disease diagnostics for laboratory monkeys. This work aims to provide a theoretical and practical reference for clinical practice and scientific research focused on laboratory monkey disease prevention and control.
abstract_zh: 实验猴作为与人类遗传关系最密切的非人灵长类动物模型,在生命科学研究、药物研发、生物制品评价等方面都不可或缺。然而,传染病无论是在实验室猴群中流行,还是在繁殖和饲养过程中获得,例如 B 病毒和结核分枝杆菌,都会威胁动物福利和群落安全,同时也会增加人畜共患 传播 风险并损害研究数据的可靠性。实验室猴子疾病的多样性、复杂性和临床隐蔽性对兽医诊断能力提出了严格的要求。本文综述了应用于实验室猴病监测的主流兽医诊断技术的现状和最新进展。我们分析了分子、免疫学、成像和传统微生物学方法在检测实验猴主要病毒、细菌和寄生虫病原体方面的具体应用、优势和局限性,涵盖定量 PCR (qPCR)、基于 CRISPR 的检测、ELISA、IFA/IHC 和其他已建立的平台。通过比较这些技术的敏感性、特异性、成本效益和操作可行性,我们描述了它们对不同用例的适用性:高精度实验室检测、大规模菌落筛查和护理点临床 诊断。目前针对实验室猴子的兽医诊断分析实现了稳健的分析性能。在多项研究中,qPCR 对 B 病毒检测具有 100% 的灵敏度和 100% 的特异性,数字 PCR (dPCR) 对猴痘病毒的检测限低至 45 拷贝/ml;基于 CRISPR/Cas 的检测在临床验证 队列研究 中表现出 100% 的敏感性和 100% 的特异性。基于这些进展,我们进一步确定了诊断部署中的实际瓶颈,并提出了有针对性的对策。最后,我们探讨了即时检测、多重病原体检测和人工智能辅助的诊断的新兴趋势和应用前景,共同支持实验室猴准确、高效、智能的疾病诊断的发展。本研究旨在为实验室猴病防治的临床实践和科研提供理论和实践参考。

title: FOLIC ACID AND RELATED FOLATES AS PROPOSED INHIBITORS OF ORTHOPOXVIRUS MRNA CAP METHYLTRANSFERASES: A NARRATIVE REVIEW OF EVIDENCE AND LIMITATIONS
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) replicates in the host cell cytoplasm and must therefore encode its own messenger RNA capping machinery, which makes the viral cap methyltransferases attractive antiviral targets. Folic acid has recently been proposed as an inhibitor of these enzymes and, on that basis, as a candidate treatment for MPXV. This narrative review examines that proposition and the level of evidence supporting it. PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched through May 2026; no original experimental work was undertaken. The proposal rests almost entirely on a single virtual screening study in which folic acid emerged as a high-scoring ligand in molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations, supported indirectly by reports that folates and folate antagonists modulate the replication of unrelated viruses. No published study demonstrates concentration-dependent inhibition of a purified orthopoxvirus methyltransferase by folic acid, and no kinetic parameters have been determined. Folate biochemistry offers no straightforward mechanism because S-adenosylmethionine, rather than folate, is the methyl donor for these enzymes and folate contributes only indirectly by supplying that pool. Furthermore, reported antiviral activity at millimolar concentrations exceeds achievable plasma exposures by approximately three orders of magnitude. By contrast, sinefungin-derived inhibitors of the MPXV 2′-O-methyltransferase VP39 have been characterized structurally, inhibit the purified enzyme at submicromolar concentrations, and suppress viral replication in cell culture, confirming that this machinery is druggable. Folic acid is therefore best described as a computationally derived hypothesis requiring enzymatic validation, rather than an established methyltransferase inhibitor or a therapy for MPXV.

abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 在 宿主 细胞质中复制,因此必须编码其自己的信使 RNA 加帽机制,这使得病毒帽甲基转移酶成为有吸引力的 宿主 靶点。最近有人提出叶酸作为这些酶的抑制剂,并在此基础上作为 MPXV 的候选 治疗。这篇叙述性评论审查了该命题以及支持该命题的证据水平。PubMed、Scopus 和 Google Scholar 的搜索时间截至 2026 年 5 月;没有进行任何原始的实验工作。该提议几乎完全依赖于一项虚拟筛选研究,其中叶酸作为分子对接和分子动力学模拟中的高分配体出现,并得到叶酸和叶酸拮抗剂调节不相关病毒复制的报告的间接支持。尚未发表的研究表明叶酸对纯化的 正痘病毒 甲基转移酶具有浓度依赖性抑制作用,并且尚未确定动力学参数。叶酸生物化学没有提供直接的机制,因为这些酶的甲基供体是 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸,而不是叶酸,而叶酸仅通过提供该池来间接贡献。此外,报道的毫摩尔浓度下的 抗病毒药物 活性超过可达到的血浆暴露量大约三个数量级。相比之下,辛芬净衍生的 MPXV 2'-O-甲基转移酶 VP39 抑制剂已在结构上进行了表征,在亚微摩尔浓度下抑制纯化的酶,并抑制细胞培养物中的病毒复制,证实了该机制是可成药的。因此,叶酸最好被描述为需要酶验证的计算得出的假设,而不是已建立的甲基转移酶抑制剂或 MPXV 疗法。

title: An Integrated Mobile Laboratory Workflow for Wastewater and Environmental Pathogen Surveillance: Performance Evaluation and Field Application in Sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: Abstract Mobile laboratories (MLs) offer a practical solution for decentralized wastewater and environmental surveillance in settings with limited laboratory infrastructure, cold-chain logistics, and trained personnel. However, field-deployable molecular workflows suitable for diverse environmental matrices have not been systematically evaluated. Here, we present an integrated ML workflow combining Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) sequencing for shotgun metagenomics, multiplex small-subunit (SSU) rRNA metabarcoding, and portable qPCR for targeted pathogen detection. Nucleic acid extraction was optimized and evaluated across wastewater and sediment matrices. Workflow performance was assessed using the ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard and wastewater spiked with inactivated mpox virus (MPXV), demonstrating comparable taxonomic recovery and consistent MPXV detection across spike concentrations. Multiplex SSU rRNA metabarcoding enabled simultaneous profiling of bacteria, archaea, and microeukaryotes, while 16S rRNA-derived community composition showed strong agreement with ONT-based 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing. Multiple displacement amplification combined with rapid barcoding reliably reproduced mock community composition across environmental matrices. As a proof-of-concept, the workflow was applied to environmental samples from sub-Saharan Africa, detecting priority pathogens and antimicrobial resistance genes consistent with the local epidemiological context. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and field adaptability of the workflow for One Health pathogen and antimicrobial resistance surveillance in resource-limited settings.

Here, we present an integrated ML workflow combining Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) sequencing for shotgun metagenomics, multiplex small-subunit (SSU) rRNA metabarcoding, and portable qPCR for targeted pathogen detection. Nucleic acid extraction was optimized and evaluated across wastewater and sediment matrices. Workflow performance was assessed using the ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard and wastewater spiked with inactivated mpox virus (MPXV), demonstrating comparable taxonomic recovery and consistent MPXV detection across spike concentrations. Multiplex SSU rRNA metabarcoding enabled simultaneous profiling of bacteria, archaea, and microeukaryotes, while 16S rRNA-derived community composition showed strong agreement with ONT-based 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing. Multiple displacement amplification combined with rapid barcoding reliably reproduced mock community composition across environmental matrices. As a proof-of-concept, the workflow was applied to environmental samples from sub-Saharan Africa, detecting priority pathogens and antimicrobial resistance genes consistent with the local epidemiological context. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and field adaptability of the workflow for One Health pathogen and antimicrobial resistance surveillance in resource-limited settings.

abstract_zh: 摘要 移动实验室 (ML) 为实验室基础设施、冷链物流和训练有素的人员有限的环境中的分散废水和环境 监测 提供了实用的解决方案。然而,适用于不同环境基质的可现场部署的分子工作流程尚未得到系统评估。在这里,我们提出了一个集成的机器学习工作流程,结合了用于鸟枪法宏基因组学的牛津纳米孔技术 (ONT) 测序、多重小亚基 (SSU) rRNA 元条形码和用于目标病原体检测的便携式 qPCR。对废水和沉积物基质中的核酸提取进行了优化和评估。使用 ZymoBIOMICS 微生物群落标准品和掺有灭活 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 的废水评估工作流程性能,证明了可比较的分类学回收率和跨掺标浓度的一致 MPXV 检测。多重 SSU rRNA 元条形码能够同时对细菌、古细菌和微真核生物进行分析,而 16S rRNA 衍生的群落组成与基于 ONT 的 16S rRNA 扩增子测序显示出高度一致。多重位移放大与快速条形码相结合,可靠地再现了环境基质中的模拟群落组成。作为概念验证,该工作流程应用于撒哈拉以南非洲的环境样本,检测与当地流行病学背景一致的优先病原体和抗菌素耐药基因。这些发现证明了 One Health 病原体和抗菌药物耐药性 监测 在资源有限的环境中工作流程的可行性和现场适应性。

title: Strengthening Border Health Security Through Digital Surveillance: Evaluation of the Satu Sehat Health Pass System in Indonesia
abstract: Background: The increasing volume of international travel has heightened the risk of cross-border transmission of infectious diseases, necessitating effective surveillance systems at points of entry. In response to the global mpox outbreak and other emerging public health threats, Indonesia implemented the Satu Sehat Health Pass (SSHP), a digital health declaration platform for international travelers. This study evaluated the performance of the SSHP surveillance system at Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport, Makassar, Indonesia. Methods: A mixed-method surveillance system evaluation was conducted from September 2024 to April 2025 using the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) surveillance evaluation framework. Quantitative assessment examined sensitivity, positive predictive value (PPV), representativeness, data completeness, and timeliness using secondary surveillance data from 113,051 international travelers. Qualitative assessment explored simplicity, flexibility, acceptability, stability, data quality, and usefulness through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with surveillance stakeholders. Results: During the study period, 627 (0.55%) travelers were classified as high-risk or symptomatic by SSHP. The sensitivity of self-reported SSHP screening was 63.2%, while the PPV was 4.94%. Health officer assessment demonstrated superior performance, with sensitivity of 73.0% and PPV of 90.3%. Representativeness was satisfactory, with approximately 98% completeness for demographic variables. However, 81% of records contained incomplete or invalid telephone numbers, limiting follow-up investigations. The system showed good timeliness, with notifications transmitted within 24 hours. Qualitative findings indicated that SSHP was useful, flexible, and acceptable, but challenges remained regarding data quality, interoperability, and operational stability during peak travel periods. Conclusion: SSHP contributes to the early detection and monitoring of infectious disease risks among international travelers. Nevertheless, improvements in data validation, traveler compliance, system integration, and infrastructure support are needed to optimize surveillance effectiveness and strengthen border health security in Indonesia.
journal: International Journal of Statistics in Medical Research

abstract_original: Background: The increasing volume of international travel has heightened the risk of cross-border transmission of infectious diseases, necessitating effective surveillance systems at points of entry. In response to the global mpox outbreak and other emerging public health threats, Indonesia implemented the Satu Sehat Health Pass (SSHP), a digital health declaration platform for international travelers. This study evaluated the performance of the SSHP surveillance system at Sultan Hasanuddin International Airport, Makassar, Indonesia. Methods: A mixed-method surveillance system evaluation was conducted from September 2024 to April 2025 using the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) surveillance evaluation framework. Quantitative assessment examined sensitivity, positive predictive value (PPV), representativeness, data completeness, and timeliness using secondary surveillance data from 113,051 international travelers. Qualitative assessment explored simplicity, flexibility, acceptability, stability, data quality, and usefulness through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with surveillance stakeholders. Results: During the study period, 627 (0.55%) travelers were classified as high-risk or symptomatic by SSHP. The sensitivity of self-reported SSHP screening was 63.2%, while the PPV was 4.94%. Health officer assessment demonstrated superior performance, with sensitivity of 73.0% and PPV of 90.3%. Representativeness was satisfactory, with approximately 98% completeness for demographic variables. However, 81% of records contained incomplete or invalid telephone numbers, limiting follow-up investigations. The system showed good timeliness, with notifications transmitted within 24 hours. Qualitative findings indicated that SSHP was useful, flexible, and acceptable, but challenges remained regarding data quality, interoperability, and operational stability during peak travel periods. Conclusion: SSHP contributes to the early detection and monitoring of infectious disease risks among international travelers. Nevertheless, improvements in data validation, traveler compliance, system integration, and infrastructure support are needed to optimize surveillance effectiveness and strengthen border health security in Indonesia.
title_original: Strengthening Border Health Security Through Digital Surveillance: Evaluation of the Satu Sehat Health Pass System in Indonesia

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the performance of Indonesia's Satu Sehat Health Pass (SSHP) system, a digital health declaration platform for international travelers, in detecting infectious disease risks, including mpox. The mixed-method approach assessed quantitative metrics such as sensitivity, positive predictive value, representativeness, and timeliness, alongside qualitative feedback on system usability and challenges. abstract_zh: 背景:国际旅行量的增加增加了跨境传染病 传播 的风险,因此需要在入境口岸建立有效的 监测 系统。为了应对全球 猴痘 暴发 和其他新出现的公共卫生威胁,印度尼西亚实施了 Satu Sehat 健康通行证 (SSHP),这是一个面向国际旅行者的数字健康申报平台。本研究评估了印度尼西亚望加锡苏丹哈桑丁国际机场 SSHP 监测 系统的性能。方法:使用美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 监测 评估框架,于 2024 年 9 月至 2025 年 4 月进行了混合方法 监测 系统评估。定量评估使用来自 113,051 名国际旅行者的 监测 二次数据检查了敏感性、阳性预测值 (PPV)、代表性、数据完整性和及时性。定性评估通过与 监测 利益相关者的深入访谈和焦点小组讨论,探讨了简单性、灵活性、可接受性、稳定性、数据质量和有用性。结果:在研究期间,627 名 (0.55%) 旅行者被 SSHP 归类为高风险或有症状。自我报告的 SSHP 筛查的敏感性为 63.2%,而 PPV 为 4.94%。卫生官员的评估表现出优异的表现,敏感性为 73.0%,PPV 为 90.3%。代表性令人满意,人口统计变量的完整性约为 98%。然而,81%的记录包含不完整或无效的电话号码,限制了后续调查。系统时效性良好,24小时内发出通知。定性研究结果表明,SSHP 有用、灵活且可接受,但在数据质量、互操作性和高峰旅行期间的操作稳定性方面仍然存在挑战。结论:SSHP 有助于国际旅行者传染病风险的早期发现和监测。尽管如此,仍需要在数据验证、旅行者合规性、系统集成和基础设施支持方面进行改进,以优化 监测 的有效性并加强印度尼西亚的边境卫生安全。

title: A Bayesian-weighted Adaptive Ensemble for Early Multi-disease Outbreak Classification from Multi-modal Big Data Streams
abstract: Background: Across much of sub-Saharan Africa, disease-surveillance systems remain largely reactive: health authorities are often notified only after an outbreak has already been under way for days or weeks. Aim: this study develops and evaluates a Bayesian-weighted ensemble classifier that determines, from a 47-dimensional multi-modal feature vector spanning epidemiological, environmental, and digital signals, whether a weekly state–disease record represents an outbreak. Methods: four complementary learners — Random Forest, a long short-term memory (LSTM) network, XGBoost, and a hybrid combining the autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) model with a learned residual correction — are fused by a Bayesian-weighted adaptive meta-learner whose component weights are estimated by constrained cross-entropy minimisation on a validation set and whose posterior is calibrated by isotonic regression. The model was trained and evaluated on a benchmark of weekly records for five diseases endemic to Nigeria (Lassa fever, cholera, cerebrospinal meningitis, measles, and mpox) across 37 jurisdictions; the benchmark combines real NCDC and WHO AFRO surveillance statistics with a calibrated epidemiological simulation used to achieve the record volume and completeness required for controlled algorithm development. Results: On a held-out 2022–2023 test partition (N = 279,500), the ensemble attained 96.3% accuracy (95% CI: 96.2–96.4%), an F1-score of 0.939, and an AUC-ROC of 0.963, exceeding a re-implemented single-LSTM baseline on every metric (McNemar and DeLong tests, both P < .001). Probability estimates were well calibrated (Brier score 0.048), and a leave-one-learner-out ablation confirmed that every component contributed positively, with the LSTM contributing the largest marginal gain. Conclusion: disciplined model diversity combined with probability calibration yields well-behaved, decision-ready outbreak-risk scores; because the evaluation relies in part on simulated data, these figures characterise performance on a controlled benchmark rather than demonstrated real-world effectiveness, and prospective validation on live surveillance feeds is identified as the necessary next step.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of early outbreak detection in sub-Saharan Africa, where disease-surveillance systems are reactive and often only notify health authorities after an outbreak has already begun. The research focused on developing a classifier to identify outbreak status from multi-modal data.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated a Bayesian-weighted ensemble classifier on a benchmark dataset comprising weekly records for five diseases endemic to Nigeria, including mpox, across 37 jurisdictions. The dataset combined real surveillance statistics with simulated data to ensure sufficient volume and completeness for algorithm development.
analysis.methods: The model was trained using four complementary learners — Random Forest, LSTM, XGBoost, and a hybrid ARIMA with residual correction — fused by a Bayesian-weighted adaptive meta-learner. Component weights were estimated via constrained cross-entropy minimisation on a validation set, and posterior probabilities were calibrated using isotonic regression.
analysis.main_results: On a held-out test partition of 279,500 weekly records, the ensemble achieved 96.3% accuracy (95% CI: 96.2–96.4%), an F1-score of 0.939, and an AUC-ROC of 0.963, outperforming a single-LSTM baseline on all metrics (P < .001 for both McNemar and DeLong tests).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrate that combining model diversity with probability calibration produces reliable outbreak-risk scores. The study highlights the potential of multi-modal data integration for early outbreak classification, though it notes that the evaluation relied on simulated data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that the proposed method could improve early detection of mpox outbreaks, supporting more proactive public health responses. This could enhance surveillance systems and aid in timely intervention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evaluation relied on simulated data, which may limit real-world applicability. The evidence is moderate, as the study does not provide direct validation on live surveillance feeds, and further prospective testing is needed.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the reactive nature of disease-surveillance systems in sub-Saharan Africa by developing a Bayesian-weighted ensemble classifier to detect outbreaks from multi-modal data. The model was trained and tested on a benchmark dataset of weekly records for mpox and other diseases in Nigeria, combining real surveillance data with simulated records. The ensemble achieved high accuracy, F1-score, and AUC-ROC, outperforming a single-LSTM baseline. The results suggest that integrating diverse models with calibrated probabilities can yield reliable outbreak-risk scores, though the evaluation relied on simulated data, limiting real-world applicability. The findings highlight the potential of multi-modal data for early outbreak classification, which could improve public health responses. However, the study notes that further prospective validation on live surveillance feeds is necessary to confirm real-world effectiveness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区早期 暴发 检测的挑战,那里的疾病 暴发 系统是反应性的,通常只在 暴发 已经开始后才通知卫生当局。该研究的重点是开发一个分类器来从多模态数据中识别 暴发 状态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在基准数据集上评估了贝叶斯加权集成分类器,该数据集包含 37 个司法管辖区尼日利亚流行的五种疾病(包括 猴痘)的每周记录。该数据集将真实的 监测 统计数据与模拟数据相结合,以确保算法开发的足够数量和完整性。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型使用四个互补的学习器进行训练——随机森林、LSTM、XGBoost 和带有残差校正的混合 ARIMA——由贝叶斯加权自适应元学习器融合。通过验证集上的约束交叉熵最小化来估计成分权重,并使用等渗回归来校准后验概率。
elements_zh.main_results: 在包含 279,500 条每周记录的测试分区中,该集成实现了 96.3% 的准确率(95% CI:96.2–96.4%)、F1 分数为 0.939、AUC-ROC 为 0.963,在所有指标上均优于单 LSTM 基线(McNemar 和 DeLong 测试的 P < .001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,将模型多样性与概率校准相结合可产生可靠的 暴发 风险评分。该研究强调了多模式数据集成对于早期 暴发 分类的潜力,尽管它指出评估依赖于模拟数据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,所提出的方法可以改善 猴痘 暴发 的早期检测,支持更积极主动的公共卫生应对措施。这可以增强 监测 系统并有助于及时干预策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该评估依赖于模拟数据,这可能会限制现实世界的适用性。证据是中等的,因为该研究没有提供对活 监测 饲料的直接验证,需要进一步的前瞻性测试。

analysis_en.methods: The model was trained using four complementary learners — Random Forest, LSTM, XGBoost, and a hybrid ARIMA with residual correction — fused by a Bayesian-weighted adaptive meta-learner. Component weights were estimated via constrained cross-entropy minimisation on a validation set, and posterior probabilities were calibrated using isotonic regression.
analysis_en.main_results: On a held-out test partition of 279,500 weekly records, the ensemble achieved 96.3% accuracy (95% CI: 96.2–96.4%), an F1-score of 0.939, and an AUC-ROC of 0.963, outperforming a single-LSTM baseline on all metrics (P < .001 for both McNemar and DeLong tests).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The results demonstrate that combining model diversity with probability calibration produces reliable outbreak-risk scores. title_zh: 用于来自多模态大数据流的早期多疾病 暴发 分类的贝叶斯加权自适应集成
source_body_en: Background: Across much of sub-Saharan Africa, disease-surveillance systems remain largely reactive: health authorities are often notified only after an outbreak has already been under way for days or weeks. Aim: this study develops and evaluates a Bayesian-weighted ensemble classifier that determines, from a 47-dimensional multi-modal feature vector spanning epidemiological, environmental, and digital signals, whether a weekly state–disease record represents an outbreak. Methods: four complementary learners — Random Forest, a long short-term memory (LSTM) network, XGBoost, and a hybrid combining the autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) model with a learned residual correction — are fused by a Bayesian-weighted adaptive meta-learner whose component weights are estimated by constrained cross-entropy minimisation on a validation set and whose posterior is calibrated by isotonic regression. The model was trained and evaluated on a benchmark of weekly records for five diseases endemic to Nigeria (Lassa fever, cholera, cerebrospinal meningitis, measles, and mpox) across 37 jurisdictions; the benchmark combines real NCDC and WHO AFRO surveillance statistics with a calibrated epidemiological simulation used to achieve the record volume and completeness required for controlled algorithm development. Results: On a held-out 2022–2023 test partition (N = 279,500), the ensemble attained 96.3% accuracy (95% CI: 96.2–96.4%), an F1-score of 0.939, and an AUC-ROC of 0.963, exceeding a re-implemented single-LSTM baseline on every metric (McNemar and DeLong tests, both P < .001). Probability estimates were well calibrated (Brier score 0.048), and a leave-one-learner-out ablation confirmed that every component contributed positively, with the LSTM contributing the largest marginal gain. Conclusion: disciplined model diversity combined with probability calibration yields well-behaved, decision-ready outbreak-risk scores; because the evaluation relies in part on simulated data, these figures characterise performance on a controlled benchmark rather than demonstrated real-world effectiveness, and prospective validation on live surveillance feeds is identified as the necessary next step.
abstract_zh: 背景:在撒哈拉以南非洲的大部分地区,疾病 暴发 系统在很大程度上仍处于反应状态:通常只有在 暴发 已经进行数天或数周后,卫生当局才会收到通知。目的:本研究开发并评估了贝叶斯加权集成分类器,该分类器根据涵盖流行病学、环境和数字信号的 47 维多模态特征 媒介 来确定每周的州疾病记录是否代表 暴发。方法:四个互补学习器——随机森林、长短期记忆 (LSTM) 网络、XGBoost 以及自回归积分移动平均 (ARIMA) 模型与学习残差校正相结合的混合模型——由贝叶斯加权自适应元学习器融合,其分量权重通过验证集上的约束交叉熵最小化来估计,其后验通过等渗回归进行校准。该模型根据 37 个管辖区尼日利亚流行的五种疾病(拉沙热、霍乱、脑脊髓膜炎、麻疹和 猴痘)的每周记录基准进行了训练和评估;该基准将真实的 NCDC 和 WHO AFRO 监测 统计数据与经过校准的流行病学模拟相结合,用于实现受控算法开发所需的记录量和完整性。结果:在 2022-2023 年测试分区(N = 279,500)上,集成达到了 96.3% 的准确率(95% CI:96.2-96.4%),F1 分数为 0.939,AUC-ROC 为 0.963,在每个指标上都超过了重新实现的单 LSTM 基线(McNemar 和DeLong 测试,均 P < .001)。概率估计得到了很好的校准(Brier 得分 0.048),留一学习者消融证实每个组件都做出了积极贡献,其中 LSTM 贡献了最大的边际收益。结论:严格的模型多样性与概率校准相结合,可产生表现良好、可供决策使用的 暴发 风险评分;由于评估部分依赖于模拟数据,这些数字表征了受控基准上的性能,而不是证明了现实世界的有效性,并且对实时 监测 源的前瞻性验证被认为是下一步必要的步骤。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决撒哈拉以南非洲地区早期 暴发 检测的挑战,那里的疾病 暴发 系统是反应性的,通常只在 暴发 已经开始后才通知卫生当局。该研究的重点是开发一个分类器来从多模态数据中识别 暴发 状态。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在基准数据集上评估了贝叶斯加权集成分类器,该数据集包含 37 个司法管辖区尼日利亚流行的五种疾病(包括 猴痘)的每周记录。该数据集将真实的 监测 统计数据与模拟数据相结合,以确保算法开发的足够数量和完整性。
analysis_zh.methods: 该模型使用四个互补的学习器进行训练——随机森林、LSTM、XGBoost 和带有残差校正的混合 ARIMA——由贝叶斯加权自适应元学习器融合。通过验证集上的约束交叉熵最小化来估计成分权重,并使用等渗回归来校准后验概率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在包含 279,500 条每周记录的测试分区中,该集成实现了 96.3% 的准确率(95% CI:96.2–96.4%)、F1 分数为 0.939、AUC-ROC 为 0.963,在所有指标上均优于单 LSTM 基线(McNemar 和 DeLong 测试的 P < .001)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,将模型多样性与概率校准相结合可产生可靠的 暴发 风险评分。该研究强调了多模式数据集成对于早期 暴发 分类的潜力,尽管它指出评估依赖于模拟数据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,所提出的方法可以改善 猴痘 暴发 的早期检测,支持更积极主动的公共卫生应对措施。这可以增强 监测 系统并有助于及时干预策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该评估依赖于模拟数据,这可能会限制现实世界的适用性。证据是中等的,因为该研究没有提供对活 监测 饲料的直接验证,需要进一步的前瞻性测试。

title: Evaluating Active Versus Passive Surveillance under IDSR 3rd Edition in Central Africa: A Comparative Implementation Analysis of Outbreak Detection, Reporting Completeness, and Cost effectiveness (2018 to 2024)
abstract: Central Africa faces recurrent outbreaks of cholera, measles, yellow fever, Mpox, and viral haemorrhagic fevers, compounded by fragile health systems, insecurity, and limited laboratory capacity.The 3rd Edition of the Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR) framework provides updated guidance for strengthening early warning and response, yet implementation remains uneven across the region.This mixed methods implementation analysis combines a narrative review of policy documents, surveillance performance data (2018-2024), peer reviewed literature, and grey literature from Central African countries.Data were synthesized using thematic analysis and a comparative assessment guided by IDSR core functions, IHR (2005) capacities, and health system resilience dimensions (absorption, adaptation, transformation).Active surveillance approaches, including community based surveillance (CBS), active case finding, event based surveillance (EBS), and proactive rapid response teams, substantially outperformed passive facility
journal: Texila international journal of public health

analysis.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the effectiveness of active versus passive surveillance strategies under the IDSR 3rd Edition framework in Central Africa, focusing on outbreak detection, reporting completeness, and cost-effectiveness. The central question is whether active surveillance approaches, such as community-based surveillance (CBS), active case finding, event-based surveillance (EBS), and rapid response teams, are more effective than passive facility-based surveillance in detecting and responding to mpox outbreaks.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a mixed methods implementation analysis that combines a narrative review of policy documents, surveillance performance data (2018-2024), peer-reviewed literature, and grey literature from Central African countries. analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Active surveillance approaches, including CBS, active case finding, EBS, and proactive rapid response teams, substantially outperformed passive facility-based surveillance in outbreak detection, reporting completeness, and cost-effectiveness. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that implementation of the IDSR 3rd Edition framework remains uneven across Central Africa, which may affect the consistency of surveillance outcomes. There is a lack of detailed data on the long-term sustainability and scalability of active surveillance strategies in resource-limited settings.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends prioritizing active surveillance strategies to enhance outbreak detection and response in Central Africa. It also suggests the need for further research on the cost-effectiveness and scalability of these strategies, as well as the development of targeted interventions to address the specific challenges of mpox surveillance in the region.

source_body_en: Central Africa faces recurrent outbreaks of cholera, measles, yellow fever, Mpox, and viral haemorrhagic fevers, compounded by fragile health systems, insecurity, and limited laboratory capacity.The 3rd Edition of the Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR) framework provides updated guidance for strengthening early warning and response, yet implementation remains uneven across the region.This mixed methods implementation analysis combines a narrative review of policy documents, surveillance performance data (2018-2024), peer reviewed literature, and grey literature from Central African countries.Data were synthesized using thematic analysis and a comparative assessment guided by IDSR core functions, IHR (2005) capacities, and health system resilience dimensions (absorption, adaptation, transformation).Active surveillance approaches, including community based surveillance (CBS), active case finding, event based surveillance (EBS), and proactive rapid response teams, substantially outperformed passive facility

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是一种混合方法实施分析,结合了对政策文件、监测 绩效数据(2018-2024 年)、同行评审文献和中非国家灰色文献的叙述性审查。在 IDSR 核心职能、《国际卫生条例》(2005 年)能力和卫生系统复原力维度(吸收、适应、转型)的指导下,使用专题分析和比较评估来综合数据。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 主动 监测 方法,包括 CBS、主动病例查找、EBS 和主动快速响应团队,在 暴发 检测、报告完整性和成本效益方面远远优于基于被动设施的 监测。审查强调了加强监测系统以提高针对猴痘的预警和响应能力的重要性。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,IDS R 3版框架在中非地区的实施仍不均衡,这可能会影响监测结果的一致性。在资源有限的环境中,缺乏关于主动监测策略长期可持续性和可扩展性的详细数据。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议优先考虑积极的 监测 策略,以加强中部非洲的 暴发 检测和响应。它还建议需要进一步研究这些策略的成本效益和可扩展性,以及制定有针对性的干预措施,以应对该地区 猴痘 监测 的具体挑战。

title: Analysis of Mpox intervention measures in presence of environmental transmission pathway using data from DRC
abstract: This paper develops a mathematical model for Mpox transmission dynamics accounting for disease transmission through interpersonal contact as well as from microbes infested environment. The endemic equilibrium of the model was evaluated for two cases. (1) When it is assumed that the microbes in the environment play no role in the spread of the disease, and it was shown that the endemic equilibrium is unique, exists when R 0 is greater than unity, and is globally asymptotically stable. (2) For the case when environmental microbes concentration plays a role in disease transmission, the model was shown to possibly exhibit backward bifurcation at R 0 . This indicates that lowering R 0 below 1 may not eliminate Mpox when the disease is already endemic, due to the stable endemic equilibrium. Numerical results, based on outbreak data from the DRC indicate that; (1) increased interpersonal contact has the potential of making the disease worse, (2) high isolation rate and accelerated recovery of infected individuals through any possible intervention can easily contain the disease. The results further show that environmental contamination does not substantially influence disease transmission rates. More still, it is observed that implementation of influential mitigation measures results in lower and delayed peaks of the number of infected. This is essential for healthcare systems to prepare for more emergency cases and isolation facilities when needed most especially in under resourced communities or countries. Our findings highlight the need for comprehensive interventions addressing both behavioural and environmental factors, especially in environments with limited resources.

abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个 猴痘 传播 动态数学模型,用于解释通过人际接触以及微生物感染环境产生的疾病 传播。对两个病例的模型的地方性平衡进行了评估。(1) 假设环境中的微生物对疾病的传播没有作用,并且证明地方病平衡是唯一的,当R 0 大于1时存在,并且全局渐近稳定。(2) 对于环境微生物浓度在疾病传播中起作用的情况,模型被证明可能在R 0 处表现出向后分岔。这表明,当疾病已经流行时,由于稳定​​的流行平衡,将 R 0 降低到 1 以下可能无法消除 猴痘。基于 DRC 的 暴发 数据的数值结果表明: (1)人际接触增加有可能使疾病恶化,(2)高隔离率和感染个体的加速康复通过任何可能的干预可以轻松遏制疾病。结果进一步表明,环境污染并没有显着影响疾病 传播 的发病率。更重要的是,据观察,实施有影响力的缓解措施会导致感染人数的峰值降低和延迟。这对于医疗保健系统在最需要时为更多紧急情况和隔离设施做好准备至关重要,特别是在资源匮乏的社区或国家。我们的研究结果强调需要针对行为和环境因素采取综合干预措施,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
summary_zh: 本文开发了一个 猴痘 传播 动态数学模型,用于解释通过人际接触以及微生物感染环境产生的疾病 传播。对两个病例的模型的地方性平衡进行了评估。(1) 假设环境中的微生物对疾病的传播没有作用,并且证明地方病平衡是唯一的,当R 0 大于1时存在,并且全局渐近稳定。(2) 对于环境微生物浓度在疾病传播中起作用的情况,模型被证明可能在R 0 处表现出向后分岔。这表明,当疾病已经流行时,由于稳定​​的流行平衡,将 R 0 降低到 1 以下可能无法消除 猴痘。基于 DRC 的 暴发 数据的数值结果表明: (1)人际接触增加有可能使疾病恶化,(2)高隔离率和感染个体的加速康复通过任何可能的干预可以轻松遏制疾病。结果进一步表明,环境污染并没有显着影响疾病 传播 的发病率。更重要的是,据观察,实施有影响力的缓解措施会导致感染人数的峰值降低和延迟。这对于医疗保健系统在最需要时为更多紧急情况和隔离设施做好准备至关重要,特别是在资源匮乏的社区或国家。我们的研究结果强调需要针对行为和环境因素采取综合干预措施,特别是在资源有限的环境中。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本文开发了一个数学模型,用于分析猴痘 传播动态,考虑了通过人际接触以及微生物污染环境传播疾病的影响。本研究旨在了解环境传播在猴痘传播中的作用以及干预措施的有效性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了两种情况下数学模型的地方性平衡:(1)当环境微生物在疾病 传播 中没有发挥作用时,以及(2)当它们确实发挥作用时。该模型基于 DRC 的 暴发 数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 该模型针对两种情况进行了评估:(1) 当环境微生物在疾病 传播 中没有发挥作用时,以及 (2) 当它们确实发挥作用时。结果基于刚果民主共和国的 暴发 数据。
analysis_zh.main_results: 基于刚果民主共和国 暴发 数据的数值结果表明,人际接触增加有可能使疾病恶化,而通过任何可能的干预措施,感染者的高隔离率和加速康复可以轻松遏制疾病。环境污染不会显着影响疾病 传播 发病率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,当疾病已经流行时,由于稳定​​的流行平衡,将 R 0 降低到 1 以下可能无法消除 猴痘。研究结果强调需要针对行为和环境因素采取综合干预措施,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以告知医疗保健系统在需要时为更多紧急情况和隔离设施做好准备,特别是在资源匮乏的社区或国家。需要综合干预措施来有效管理 猴痘 暴发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了数学模型,并且依赖于DRC的暴发数据。
